title: 1620 and 1637 Prairie's cornices meet their mansard eaves
items: On the two mansard-roofed houses on Prairie, the bracketed cornice, its bed moulding and the brick wall head now rise to the soffit the roof actually builds; they had stopped about 9-11 cm short of it.
1637 Prairie's swell bay rises with its cornice, so the band carried round the bow now runs level with the main eave.
